auth_password_help: 15 characters minimum. A sentence works very well.
auth_password_compromised: This password appears in known data breaches, choose another one.
auth_password_check_unavailable: This password could not be checked right now. Try again in a moment.
auth_check_inbox_body: An email was just sent to {email}. Click the link it contains to continue: it is valid for 24 hours.
auth_link_resent: The link was just sent again.
auth_link_invalid_title: This link is no longer valid
auth_error: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
email_footer: Do not reply to this email.
email_verify_intro: Click this link to confirm your address and open your BattleCRM account. It is valid for 24 hours and works only once.
email_verify_ignore: If you did not ask for an account, ignore this email: no account will be created.
email_account_exists_intro: Someone, probably you, just asked for a BattleCRM account with this address. It already has one.
email_account_exists_reset: Forgot your password? Reset it here:
email_account_exists_ignore: If it was not you, there is nothing to do.
auth_link_invalid_body: It has expired or was already used.
auth_too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes, or reset your password.
email_new_device_subject: New sign-in to your BattleCRM account
email_new_device_intro: Your account was just opened from a device that had never signed in to it:
email_new_device_not_me: If it was you, there is nothing to do. If not, choose a new password: all your devices will be signed out.
auth_forgot_password_body: Enter the address of your account to receive a reset link.
auth_forgot_password_sent: If an account exists for this address, a link was just sent.
account_password_body: Changing your password signs your other devices out.
account_password_changed: Password changed. Your other devices are signed out.
account_too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
email_password_reset_intro: Click this link to choose a new password. It is valid for 1 hour and works only once.
email_password_reset_ignore: If you did not ask for anything, ignore this email: your password does not change.
email_password_changed_intro: The password of your BattleCRM account was just changed. Your other devices were signed out.
email_password_changed_not_me: If it was you, there is nothing to do. If not, choose a new password right away.
email_change_confirm_intro: Click this link to use this address with your BattleCRM account. It is valid for 1 hour and works only once.
email_change_confirm_ignore: If you did not ask for anything, ignore this email: nothing changes.
email_change_notice_intro: A change of email address was just requested for your BattleCRM account, to {email}. It takes effect when the link sent to that address is clicked.
email_change_notice_not_me: If it was you, there is nothing to do. If not, choose a new password right away: the request will be cancelled.
account_email_body: The change takes effect when you click the link sent to the new address.
account_email_sent: A link was just sent to {email}. Your address will change when you click it: it is valid for 1 hour.
email_two_factor_enabled_intro: Two-factor authentication was just turned on for your BattleCRM account. A code will be asked at every sign-in.
email_two_factor_disabled_intro: Two-factor authentication was just turned off for your BattleCRM account. Your password alone signs you in again.
email_two_factor_not_me: If it was you, there is nothing to do. Otherwise, choose a new password right away.
auth_two_factor_body: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your backup codes.
auth_two_factor_expired: Signing in took too long. Start again with your password.
auth_two_factor_reset_help: The 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your backup codes.
account_two_factor_off: A code from your authenticator app will be asked at every sign-in, on top of your password.
account_two_factor_scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, or type the key by hand. Then give the code it shows.
account_backup_codes_body: Each code works once, when you do not have your app at hand. They will never be shown again.
account_backup_codes_saved: I have put my codes somewhere safe
account_backup_codes_low: Few are left: make new ones.
email_two_factor_recovery_started_intro: Someone who knows your password said they no longer have your authenticator app or your backup codes. Two-factor authentication will be turned off for your BattleCRM account on {date}.
email_two_factor_recovery_reminder_subje: Reminder: two-factor authentication will soon be turned off
email_two_factor_recovery_reminder_intro: A recovery is under way on your BattleCRM account: two-factor authentication will be turned off on {date}.
email_two_factor_recovery_not_me: If it was you, there is nothing to do. Otherwise, cancel the request, then choose a new password: someone knows yours.
email_two_factor_recovery_completed_subj: Recovery complete: two-factor authentication is off
email_two_factor_recovery_completed_intr: The 7 days of the recovery have passed: two-factor authentication was just turned off for your BattleCRM account. Your password alone signs you in again; you can turn it back on in Settings.
auth_recovery_lost: I can no longer get a code
auth_recovery_body: Without your authenticator app or a backup code, you can ask for two-factor authentication to be turned off. It takes effect after 7 days: an email warns you right away, and its link cancels the request.
auth_recovery_requested: Two-factor authentication will be turned off on {date}. Your password alone will then sign you in. An email was sent to you: its link cancels the request.
auth_recovery_cancelled_body: Two-factor authentication stays on for your account. If the request did not come from you, someone knows your password: choose a new one.
undo_too_late: This can no longer be undone.
undo_failed: Undo didn't work. Try again in a moment.
contacts_empty_body: Add someone to prospect: only a name is required.
contacts_load_error: Your Contacts could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
contact_stage_gone: This Stage is no longer in the Funnel: choose another one.
organization_type_required: Choose the type of this new Organization.
organization_taken: This Organization already exists: it is chosen instead, check then add.
no_organization_matches: No Organization matches: it will be created.
contact_linkedin_url_invalid: Enter the address of a LinkedIn profile, like linkedin.com/in/jane-doe.
contact_same_name: A Contact already has this name: {contact}
contact_same_name_in_organization: A Contact already has this name at {organization}
contact_same_phone: This phone number already belongs to {contact}
contact_unknown: This Contact does not exist, or no longer does.
contact_thread_load_error: The thread could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
contact_edit_changes_trial: The Trial in progress keeps its starting Target
organization_taken_on_edit: This Organization already exists: it is chosen instead, check then save.
organization_unknown: This Organization does not exist, or no longer does.
organization_name_taken: Another Organization already has this name.
organization_trials_keep_target: Trials already started keep their Target.
organization_changed_elsewhere: This Organization changed on another device: check, then try again.
organization_merge_choose: Choose the Organization to merge with.
next_action_archived: Nothing is final: you can bring them back.
change_status_behind: This Contact changed on another device: check, then try again.
